ارتعفتا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَفَتَا (irtaʕafatā) /ir.ta.ʕa.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اُرْتُعِفَتَا (urtuʕifatā) /ur.tu.ʕi.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
